project.name: INDEX HTML
project.creator: BeerBelgio
project.notes: Technical controls, ranges, defaults, colors, Sketch Audio Sync exposure and native host color-opacity support live in each tool manifest. Stable tool identity/type metadata (toolId, toolType), public editorial copy and preview behaviour are synchronized from the V9.2 content inventory.

copy.short: Blobs wandering around, with live, bendable links forming between them.
copy.about: Generates a population of soft moving blobs/nodes that wander through the frame. Meanwhile proximity links are generated and bent into motion-driven melted forms.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; deterministic blob population, wandering/spread, proximity links with reusable force profiles, motion/turn-driven Melt deformation, fill/core rendering; no pointer trail, source capture, ray-marching or refraction.

parameters.label: Amount
parameters.behaviour: Sets the actual number of blobs in the field.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.behaviour: Sets the radius of each blob.
parameters.explanation: Controls blob size.

parameters.label: Wandering BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the base speed of the wandering motion.
parameters.explanation: internal wandering clock, match it with yours
parameters.mapping: usually I don't map it, but go wild

parameters.label: Wandering
parameters.behaviour: Changes the irregularity and amplitude of each blob's path without changing the base playback speed.
parameters.explanation: Controls the amplitude of the blobs' paths.

parameters.label: Spread
parameters.behaviour: Changes the size of the roaming envelope the blobs move through.
parameters.explanation: Acts like expanding or shrinking the enclosure the blobs can move through.
parameters.mapping: Try using it in contrast to the "wandering" control.

parameters.label: Linking
parameters.behaviour: Controls how readily nearby blobs create live connections.
parameters.explanation: Controls how many connections the blobs create.

parameters.label: Link Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the thickness of the connecting lines.

parameters.label: Center Size
parameters.behaviour: Sets the size of each blob core.
parameters.explanation: Controls the size of each blob core.

parameters.label: Melt
parameters.behaviour: Deforms the blobs according to their motion and turning.

parameters.label: Fill Opacity
parameters.behaviour: Controls the opacity of the blob fill.

lineage.author: DavidHDev
lineage.publicText: Inspired by DavidHDev's Canvas UI Bubble component. Linking Nodes was independently rebuilt as a standalone Canvas2D tool for this project.
lineage.spark: The droplets-style behaviour ignited the idea.

development.limitations: No underlying image refraction is performed; the current tool is a generated flat-blob field.
nextIdeas: Change the blob layer order: fill, then core, then linking.

copy.short: Cassini-like shapes, two cores and a whole lot of membrane-like layers.
copy.about: Builds filled orbital slices from Cassini-oval / lemniscate-like fields. It creates something between nested loops, stretched orbits and more unstable warped orbital structures.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; two-focus product-distance Cassini field, six modes, clipped filled slices, continuous integrated Drift and independent BG controls.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of the orbital field families.
parameters.explanation: Changes how the field's force shapes the field itself.
parameters.mapping: usually I don't map it, but go wild

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.behaviour: Changes the deterministic field variation while keeping the selected orbital family.
parameters.explanation: Changes the deterministic field variation.
parameters.mapping: Map it to a point-like element so that it acts as a near-instantaneous trigger.

parameters.label: Core Separation
parameters.behaviour: Controls the distance between the two focal cores.

parameters.label: Slices
parameters.behaviour: Sets how many slice bands are generated.
parameters.explanation: How many layers do you want?
parameters.mapping: Map it along with "Seed", trip is assured

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Changes the overall spatial scale of the orbital field.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Deforms the orbital field away from its regular geometry.
parameters.explanation: Add some distortion on the entire field
parameters.mapping: everywhere will be just fine <3

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.behaviour: Controls the speed of the field's continuous autonomous motion without reposition jumps.
parameters.explanation: how much you want the system to be autonomously alive

parameters.label: Slice Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the width of the generated slice bands.

parameters.label: Accent
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many slice layers are highlighted.
parameters.explanation: Controls how many slice layers are highlighted.

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.behaviour: Rotates the entire field.

lineage.author: enonforetsam
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Cassini / lemniscate field in enonforetsam's Fluid. The current tool is an independent Canvas2D implementation.

development.limitations: Standalone generated field; no external image/source sampling.

copy.short: Points, two-color lines and basic forms. Then a multi-force warp makes the lines move fluidly and unpredictably.
copy.about: Creates string-art style line fields across several geometric boundary families, with an independently controlled accent group and optional multi-force line warping derived from the Linking Nodes deformation logic.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; nine endpoint/boundary families, explicit chord drawing, independent accent group, an internal multi-force Bézier Warp system and aspect-aware long-axis fitting for Loom/Fissure layouts.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of nine boundary / base-form families.
parameters.explanation: Change the basic form

parameters.label: Points
parameters.behaviour: Sets how many points are distributed along the selected base form.
parameters.explanation: They are distributed along the main form.

parameters.label: Multiplier
parameters.behaviour: Changes how the points are connected, reshaping the stitch-line network.
parameters.explanation: Control the lines network and how the lines are arranged

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Changes the overall size of the construction.

parameters.label: Spread
parameters.behaviour: Controls how far the line network expands beyond the base form.
parameters.explanation: How far the lines can extend beyond the basic form boundary.

parameters.label: Line Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the thickness of the base line network.

parameters.label: Accent
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many lines belong to the highlighted group.
parameters.explanation: How many cell lines do you want to highlight?

parameters.label: Accent Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the thickness of the highlighted lines.

parameters.label: Accent Variations
parameters.behaviour: Changes which lines are selected inside the highlighted group.
parameters.explanation: variation of the caustic Accent lines
parameters.mapping: Map it to a point-like element so that it acts as a near-instantaneous trigger.

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.behaviour: Rotates the entire construction.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Bends straight stitch connections into fluid, asymmetric curves through the internal multi-force deformation system.
parameters.explanation: Turns straight connections into fluid, asymmetric curves driven by independent forces.

lineage.author: enonforetsam
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Stitch caustic concept in enonforetsam's Fluid. The current line engine is independently implemented.

development.limitations: Generated line construction only; it does not trace an underlying image.
nextIdeas: Make the wires feel more alive during Warp.

copy.short: A digital cellular ecosystem. Did you pay attention in biology class?
copy.about: Generates a living cellular field with separate cores, inner gaps and membranes, then deforms the field with animated warp. The target is an organic/tissue-like system that can move from stable cells into more distorted morphologies without becoming illustrative.
copy.implementation: WebGL; standard Worley F1/F2 neighbourhood core with its own hash/feature motion, accumulated warp-drift phase, multi-band deformation, membrane/core/gap model and premultiplied-alpha BG composition.

parameters.label: Drift BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the base temporal clock for the cellular field.
parameters.explanation: internal drift clock, match it with yours
parameters.mapping: usually I don't map it, but go wild

parameters.label: Cell Count
parameters.behaviour: Changes the density / apparent scale of the cellular field.
parameters.explanation: Kinda like the zoom of the microscope or the cellule density

parameters.label: Core Size
parameters.behaviour: Controls the size of each cellular core relative to the available cell area.
parameters.explanation: Depending on Cell Count, the cellular core grows until it occupies all available space, then shrinks according to the cellular morph.

parameters.label: Inner Gap
parameters.behaviour: Controls the gap between each core and its surrounding membrane.
parameters.explanation: The gap between the core and the cellular membrane

parameters.label: Membrane
parameters.behaviour: Controls the thickness of the cellular membranes.
parameters.explanation: How thick the membrane is. Attention though: they will cover up the entire space!

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Controls the overall amount of organic deformation applied to the field.
parameters.explanation: Organic deformation of the whole ecosystem

parameters.label: Warp Scale
parameters.behaviour: Controls the spatial scale / frequency of the warp deformation.
parameters.explanation: How 'strong' the organic deformation is

parameters.label: Warp Drift
parameters.behaviour: Controls how quickly the warp deformation moves through the field.
parameters.explanation: Linked to the BPM control; sets how much the ecosystem flows.

parameters.label: Warp Complexity
parameters.behaviour: Controls the number and intensity of secondary folds in the deformation.
parameters.explanation: Bring the distortion to a whole new level

lineage.author: enonforetsam
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Cellular / Worley–Voronoi language in enonforetsam's Fluid. The current WebGL implementation is independently built.

development.limitations: Current file generates its own field; it does not sample the layer below it.

copy.short: Chladni figures with variable morphing and warped motion.
copy.about: Generates Chladni-like nodal figures on the GPU, morphing between modal states and rendering through an adaptive supersampled WebGL pass.
copy.implementation: WebGL; canonical Chladni minus-family equation with analytic gradient, explicit Mode X/Y pairs, morphing and warp/rotation; rendered to an adaptive supersampled framebuffer before blitting to output.

parameters.label: Mode X
parameters.behaviour: Selects the X component of the Chladni modal pair.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with Mode Y

parameters.label: Mode Y
parameters.behaviour: Selects the Y component of the Chladni modal pair.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with Mode X

parameters.label: Morph
parameters.behaviour: Blends the current modal pair toward the neighbouring modal state.

parameters.label: Line Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the thickness of the visible nodal bands.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Deforms the nodal field and introduces animated spatial movement above zero.
parameters.explanation: Distort the whole field, at '0' value the whole field will be still, for parameter values > 1 the whole field will be alive
parameters.mapping: everywhere will be just fine <3

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.behaviour: Rotates / reorients the nodal pattern.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the temporal clock for the animated field motion.
parameters.explanation: internal warp clock, match it with yours
parameters.mapping: usually I don't map it, but go wild

parameters.label: BG Opacity
parameters.behaviour: Controls the opacity of the BG layer.

lineage.author: enonforetsam
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Chladni / nodal field work in enonforetsam's Fluid and by standard Chladni plate mathematics. The current WebGL implementation is independently built.

development.limitations: The visual system is mathematically inspired by Chladni figures but is not intended as a scientific simulator.
nextIdeas: Explore a genuinely audio-derived nodal response rather than only mapping controls onto a mathematical Chladni construction.

copy.short: Basic forms, cut into slices. Whether it becomes the main composition object or just a layering mask is up to you, go wild.
copy.about: Generates a simple source shape, keeps a stable base copy visible, then fragments and displaces a second copy when Trigger fires. It is a shape-decomposition tool built for punchy, event-like cuts.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; internally generated circles/rectangles/stripes, stable base plus fragmented copy, six cut modes using rectangle/wedge clipping, displacement, rotation and echoes.

parameters.label: Cut Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects the cutting family: bands, grid scatter, radial burst, wedges or repeated echoes.

parameters.label: Source
parameters.behaviour: Selects the internally generated source shape / pattern.
parameters.explanation: The basic shapes
parameters.mapping: usually I don't map it, but go wild

parameters.label: Trigger
parameters.behaviour: Drives the cutting event directly.
parameters.explanation: Cut everything!
parameters.mapping: Map it to a point-like element so that it acts as a near-instantaneous trigger.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Controls the size of the generated source.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with Stroke Width

parameters.label: Stroke Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls outline thickness for outlined source shapes.
parameters.explanation: Apply only to outline shapes

parameters.label: Cut Density
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many cuts / fragments are generated.
parameters.explanation: How many cuts

parameters.label: Cut Size
parameters.behaviour: Controls the size of the generated cut pieces.
parameters.explanation: how the scraps will scatter in the 'displacement' parameter values
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'displacement'

parameters.label: Displacement
parameters.behaviour: Controls how far the cut pieces move away from their source positions.
parameters.explanation: how the scraps will scatter
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'cut size'

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.behaviour: Controls the rotational component of the cut / displaced pieces.

lineage.author: markdo27
lineage.publicText: FormCutter grew from a broader study of markdo27's previous version of Typoman and Flash-style kinetic visual grammar. All code was independently built for this project.

development.limitations: It cannot cut/rearrange the actual layer below. The current implementation only fragments its own generated source.

copy.short: Random, irregular and warped fragments for multilayer masking.
copy.about: Builds a grid of irregular polygonal fragments and controls which cells are visible, how much of each cell is filled, how opaque the result is and the two-color fragment/BG palette.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; ordered weighted grid cuts, strongly asymmetric but non-self-intersecting cells, coverage ranking, fragment shrink/fill, independent Fill/BG colors and 2 px seam-overlap compensation.

parameters.label: Layout
parameters.behaviour: Selects the overall fracture bias: balanced, horizontal or vertical.
parameters.explanation: Square or orthogonal axes

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.behaviour: Changes the deterministic fracture arrangement.
parameters.explanation: Order variation
parameters.mapping: Map it to a point-like element so that it acts as a near-instantaneous trigger.

parameters.label: Density
parameters.behaviour: Controls the number of subdivisions / fragments.

parameters.label: Cut Asymmetry
parameters.behaviour: Controls the size imbalance between neighbouring fragments.
parameters.explanation: adjusts the regularity of the margins

parameters.label: Coverage Distribution
parameters.behaviour: Controls which fragments are active and therefore how coverage is distributed.
parameters.explanation: How much coverage do you want?
parameters.mapping: Another trigger-like component --> Map it to a point-like element so that it acts as a near-instantaneous trigger.

parameters.label: Fragment Fill
parameters.behaviour: Controls how much of each active fragment is filled from its centre toward its edges.
parameters.explanation: How much of each fragment is filled, from the center toward the edges.

parameters.label: Fill Opacity
parameters.behaviour: Controls the overall opacity of the rendered mask.

lineage.author: BeerBelgio
lineage.publicText: Developed alongside FormCutter from the same internal masking/cutting exploration; it is a sibling idea, not a code derivative.

development.limitations: It generates its own mask polygons; it does not fracture the pixels of the layer below by itself.
nextIdeas: Use the generated fracture as a true interactive mask between upstream / downstream visual layers once the browser host can expose source content.

copy.short: A flow of particles in basic shapes, ready to be unleashed.
copy.about: Generates a dense moving particle front with directional progression, independently scalable particles, scatter, turbulence, trailing dust and grain.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; generated particle lattice driven by a Progress front, ten metric/direction patterns, independent particle sizing, scatter, turbulence, trail, grain and two-colour mixing; no upstream-content sampling.

parameters.label: Progress
parameters.behaviour: Moves the active particle front through the frame.
parameters.explanation: It's the main event, treat it as such

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of the directional / radial progression metrics.
parameters.explanation: change the shape of the main event

parameters.label: Amount
parameters.behaviour: Controls particle density.
parameters.explanation: How many particles

parameters.label: Particle Size
parameters.behaviour: Scales the radius of each particle independently of particle density.

parameters.label: Edge Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the width of the active particle front.
parameters.explanation: The width of the main shape

parameters.label: Scatter
parameters.behaviour: Pushes particles away from their original positions along the selected directional logic.
parameters.explanation: Scatters particles along the selected Direction.

parameters.label: Turbulence
parameters.behaviour: Adds organic motion and displacement while remaining constrained by the scatter field.
parameters.explanation: give life to the particles with an organic flow. By increasing it, they will move faster and travel further from the original position, while remaining within the 'scatter' values.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the temporal clock for particle turbulence / motion.
parameters.explanation: internal turbulence clock, match it with yours

parameters.label: Trail
parameters.behaviour: Extends particle freedom and residue behind the moving front.
parameters.explanation: Gives more freedom to particles on the trailing side of the selected Direction.

parameters.label: Grain
parameters.behaviour: Adds positional and opacity irregularity across the particle field.
parameters.explanation: position and color variation, treat it like adding a new color and multiply all the above parameters

lineage.author: DavidHDev
lineage.publicText: Inspired by DavidHDev's Canvas UI ParticleReveal concept. Scatter Front was independently rebuilt as a standalone Canvas2D particle generator.

development.limitations: This file does not capture or dissolve arbitrary HTML/image content underneath it; it generates the particle field itself.
nextIdeas: Allow the particle system to process an upstream visual source in the future browser pipeline.

copy.short: Not like a pirate map, but if you look hard enough, maybe you'll find a treasure here too.
copy.about: Generates animated topographic contour lines from a procedural scalar field. Several field families can produce soft terrain, ridges, rings, waves and warped contours.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; six custom scalar-field families, continuous Drift, explicit marching-squares-style contour extraction, 0–10 accent amount and independent BG controls.

parameters.label: Terrain Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects the procedural terrain / field family.
parameters.explanation: Basic terrain's algorithm

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.behaviour: Changes the deterministic terrain conformation within the selected field family.
parameters.explanation: different kind of terrain conformation

parameters.label: Levels
parameters.behaviour: Sets the number of contour levels.
parameters.explanation: kinda like changing the altitude level over the terrain

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Controls the spatial scale of the procedural field.

parameters.label: Roughness
parameters.behaviour: Controls field detail, from smoother / simpler contours to more jagged / complex ones.
parameters.explanation: lower values give simpler and smoother lines // higher values give more jagged and complex lines

parameters.label: Height Shift
parameters.behaviour: Offsets the contour thresholds, changing how the terrain morphology is sliced.
parameters.explanation: kinda like terrain morphology

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.behaviour: Animates the procedural field continuously, making the contour shapes move and melt.
parameters.explanation: Turns the whole field liquid: shapes melt and move around.

parameters.label: Line Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls contour-line thickness.

parameters.label: Accent
parameters.behaviour: Controls how much of the contour hierarchy is highlighted, from none at 0 to all at 10.
parameters.explanation: change which layer is highlighted

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.behaviour: Rotates the sampled field.

lineage.author: enonforetsam
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the topographic / contour-field concept in enonforetsam's Fluid. The current contour engine is independently implemented.

development.limitations: Procedural contour generator, not terrain data visualization.

copy.short: High-school fluid dynamics, but fun.
copy.about: Uses the Topographic procedural field as a filled-mask engine: ranked contour bands are progressively activated, with independent BG opacity and color.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D internal derivative of Topographic: retains substantial scalar-field family logic while rendering ranked clipped filled bands with adaptive sampling, BG controls and overlap compensation.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects the underlying procedural field family.
parameters.explanation: Fluid Basic Algorithm

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.behaviour: Changes the deterministic field variation within the selected family.
parameters.explanation: variation within algorithm rules

parameters.label: Levels
parameters.behaviour: Sets the number of ranked contour bands available to the mask.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Controls the spatial scale of the procedural field.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Controls the detail / deformation of the procedural field.
parameters.explanation: Warp the whole fluid field

parameters.label: Band Shift
parameters.behaviour: Offsets the disposition of the filled contour bands.
parameters.explanation: Change the concentric layers disposition

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.behaviour: Animates the procedural field continuously, controlling the apparent flow / melting speed.
parameters.explanation: viscosity of the fluid, treat it like the velocity of melting

parameters.label: Mask Fill
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many ranked bands are filled.
parameters.explanation: how many layers are filled

parameters.label: BG Opacity
parameters.behaviour: Controls the opacity of the BG layer.

lineage.author: BeerBelgio
lineage.publicText: Derived internally from Topographic, reworking the same procedural field into a filled-mask system.

lineage.author: enonforetsam
lineage.publicText: Topographic Mask inherits Fluid's conceptual lineage indirectly through its Topographic parent.

copy.short: Basic shapes, photography concepts and middle-school geometry: can something go wrong?
copy.about: Generates a basic geometric source and applies trigger-driven Flash-style cuts, slotting, wedge splits, echoes and radial copy movements.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; offscreen generated geometric shapes and six direct-Trigger scene families using rectangular/wedge clipping, slotting, echoes and radial copies; independent X/Y stretch; no text engine or p5 dependency.

parameters.label: FX Type
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of six FX / transition families.
parameters.explanation: Actual FX type

parameters.label: Shape
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of six internally generated source shapes.

parameters.label: Trigger
parameters.behaviour: Acts as the direct FX envelope, controlling how much of the selected effect is applied.
parameters.explanation: It's the main event, treat it as such. It acts like a dry/wet control for the FX amount.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'impact'

parameters.label: Impact
parameters.behaviour: Controls the displacement strength / intensity of the triggered effect.
parameters.explanation: How strongly the selected FX responds once Trigger is active.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'Trigger'.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Controls the size of the generated source shape.

parameters.label: Horizontal Stretch
parameters.behaviour: Stretches the source horizontally.

parameters.label: Vertical Stretch
parameters.behaviour: Stretches the source vertically.

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.behaviour: Controls the rotational component of the selected transition.

parameters.label: Split
parameters.behaviour: Controls how strongly the source is divided into separated regions.
parameters.explanation: Sets the boundaries for Impact and Trigger.

parameters.label: Shutter
parameters.behaviour: Further segments / opens the split effect around the focal structure.
parameters.explanation: Further splits the focus, enhancing the Split effect.

lineage.author: markdo27
lineage.publicText: Inspired by markdo27's previous version of Typoman and its kinetic Flash-style transition grammar. FormShift is an independent shape-based implementation.

development.limitations: Like FormCutter, the current implementation transforms its own generated source canvas; it does not decompose the actual lower layer without an exposed source texture/canvas.

copy.short: "Flowers are blooming everywhere"
copy.about: Generates a layered radial system of dashed trajectories that behaves like a synthetic flowerish shape.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; deterministic three-layer radial field; curved multi-sample ray paths; segmented dash/gap stroke system; per-ray irregularity; moving accent beads fixed at 125% of line width; extended off-axis center positioning; full-range layer spread up to a 360° relationship; transparent output.

parameters.label: Rays
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many radial trajectories are generated around the system.
parameters.explanation: Exponential petals

parameters.label: Size
parameters.behaviour: Sets the overall radius of the flower structure.

parameters.label: Ragged
parameters.behaviour: Introduces per-ray irregularity in angle, length and micro-deformation.
parameters.explanation: Make the flower more organic and unstable.
parameters.mapping: Works well with moderate motion and width changes.

parameters.label: Center X
parameters.behaviour: Moves the system center horizontally, including beyond the canvas midpoint range.

parameters.label: Center Y
parameters.behaviour: Moves the system center vertically, including beyond the canvas midpoint range.

parameters.label: Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the stroke width of all rays.

parameters.label: Dash
parameters.behaviour: Sets the visible dash length of the segmented lines.
parameters.explanation: Lines or Dots?
parameters.mapping: Try to map it to a point-like element so that it acts as a near-instantaneous trigger.

parameters.label: Gap
parameters.behaviour: Sets the distance between line segments.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'Dash'

parameters.label: Bend
parameters.behaviour: Curves the rays into petal-like arcs instead of keeping them strictly radial.
parameters.explanation: Expand the geometry behind the flower

parameters.label: Beads
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many accent markers appear along the rays.
parameters.explanation: Roller coaster on a flower

parameters.label: Layer Spread
parameters.behaviour: Controls the angular separation between the three fixed radial strata.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the internal motion clock for drift, bead travel and breathing.

lineage.author: PLAYGRND / PlayLab
lineage.sourceLicence: No code or licence reuse; reference-only visual research
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Dahlia generator on PLAYGRND. Kinda Flower is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D radial system focused on segmented lines, layered spread and bead accents.

copy.short: A [syn] approach to Joy Division
copy.about: Generates a repeated interlocking line field built from synchronized rows. Row count, spacing, tooth geometry and stagger define the base system, while bipolar Warp and Ripple engines can reinforce, counter or aggressively cross-couple through three vector modes.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; interlock-only line motor; permanently rounded joins/caps; independent row count and row spacing; horizontally overscanned lines for effectively infinite continuation; bipolar Warp and Ripple engines; three discrete vector relationships (Flow, Counter, Clash); deterministic row variation; transparent output.

parameters.label: Stripes
parameters.behaviour: Sets the number of interlocking rows generated.

parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.behaviour: Sets the physical distance between neighboring rows.

parameters.label: Weight
parameters.behaviour: Controls the stroke thickness of all rows.

parameters.label: Tooth Depth
parameters.behaviour: Controls the vertical amplitude of the interlocking teeth.
parameters.mapping: Try mapping it along or in contrast with 'Tooth Length'.

parameters.label: Tooth Length
parameters.behaviour: Sets the horizontal period/length of each tooth cycle.
parameters.mapping: Try mapping it along or in contrast with 'Tooth Depth'.

parameters.label: Stagger
parameters.behaviour: Offsets neighboring rows in phase.
parameters.explanation: A different kind of flow

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Applies a bipolar multi-frequency deformation field to the rows.
parameters.explanation: Primary high-energy deformation control.
parameters.mapping: Try mapping it along or in contrast with 'Ripple'.

parameters.label: Ripple
parameters.behaviour: Applies a bipolar travelling wave across the field.
parameters.mapping: Try mapping it along or in contrast with 'Warp'.

parameters.label: Vector Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects how Warp and Ripple vectors interact.
parameters.explanation: Increasing amount of conflict between the two parameters

parameters.label: Phase
parameters.behaviour: Offsets the pattern and deformation phase.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the internal movement rate for phase, Warp and Ripple motion.

lineage.author: PLAYGRND / PlayLab
lineage.sourceLicence: No code or licence reuse; reference-only visual research
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Zig generator on PLAYGRND. Syn Division is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D interlocking-line system focused on bipolar deformation and vector relationships.

nextIdeas: Let the lines be driven directly by the audio input.

copy.short: Angel hair is a type of pasta. I loved it as a child.
copy.about: Generates a colony of line filaments traced through a multi-scale vector field. Four structural modes reorganize the whole system, while Bundle groups strands into shared cohorts and Curl, Twist and DNA Maker push them from smooth streams toward dense fibrous or rope-like forms.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; deterministic grouped streamlines; four structural modes; multi-scale trigonometric vector field; cohort-based Bundle system with shared trajectory identity; accumulated bipolar Curl; harmonic bipolar Twist; normal-offset bipolar DNA Maker around the underlying trajectory; per-bundle accent strands; transparent output.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects the global structural organization of the filament system.

parameters.label: Lines
parameters.behaviour: Sets the number of filament strands generated.

parameters.label: Length
parameters.behaviour: Controls how long each filament is traced through the field.

parameters.label: Spread
parameters.behaviour: Controls the spatial envelope used to distribute filament origins and structural targets.

parameters.label: Bundle
parameters.behaviour: Groups individual strands into shared cohorts with increasingly similar origins and trajectories.
parameters.explanation: Low values keep filaments more independent; high values collapse them into a few strong rope-like families.

parameters.label: Field
parameters.behaviour: Sets how strongly the multi-scale vector field influences each filament trajectory.
parameters.explanation: Low values preserve the structural mode more clearly; high values pull strands into stronger field deformation.

parameters.label: Curl
parameters.behaviour: Applies strong bipolar accumulated curvature along each trajectory.
parameters.explanation: Positive and negative values bend filaments in opposite directions, with a non-linear response

parameters.label: Twist
parameters.behaviour: Adds strong bipolar alternating torsion with a secondary harmonic along each filament.
parameters.explanation: Repeatedly reverses local turning along the path; the sign flips the torsion direction.

parameters.label: DNA Maker
parameters.behaviour: Braids filaments around the shared trajectory of their bundle.
parameters.explanation: Turn everything into DNA instantly!

parameters.label: Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the stroke thickness of the filaments.

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.behaviour: Adds a slower line-specific instability on top of the structural field.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the internal animation clock used by the vector field, Twist, DNA Maker and Drift.

lineage.author: PLAYGRND / PlayLab
lineage.sourceLicence: No code or licence reuse; reference-only visual research
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Filament generator on PLAYGRND. DNA Filament is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D system focused on bundled streamlines, structural flow modes and braided fiber behavior.

nextIdeas: A future branch could explore attraction / repulsion between bundles driven by input frequencies.

copy.short: Try to scan something while someone messes with the time machine next to it.
copy.about: Generates an internal line source and reconstructs it progressively along vertical, horizontal or diagonal scan axes. Each acquired strip has its own age, allowing precise hold times, temporal offset, drift and smear to turn the reconstructed frame into a layered time-based image.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; offscreen procedural source buffer; offscreen accumulation buffer; generic clipped scan bands on four unique axes; temporal slit-scan sampling; per-strip age tracking with hard expiry; smear trail; rising-edge reset; transparent output.

parameters.label: Scan Position
parameters.behaviour: Offsets the scan head through its current direction.
parameters.explanation: At Motion BPM 0 it becomes a direct manual scan-position control; with motion running it offsets the automatic scan phase.

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of four scan axes.

parameters.label: Scan Width
parameters.behaviour: Sets the thickness of the acquisition band.

parameters.label: Temporal Offset
parameters.behaviour: Offsets source time across scan position.
parameters.explanation: Creates slit-scan temporal displacement: different areas of the reconstructed frame can come from different moments of the generated source.

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.behaviour: Moves the internally generated source while it is being scanned.

parameters.label: Hold Time (0.01s)
parameters.behaviour: Sets the lifetime of each acquired strip in hundredths of a second.
parameters.explanation: 100 = 1s - Persistence is age-based per scan strip and expires to a hard clear.

parameters.label: Smear
parameters.behaviour: Trails translucent copies behind the active scan band.
parameters.explanation: Extends the acquisition spatially along the scan direction
parameters.mapping: Pairs well with narrow Scan Width and short Hold times.

parameters.label: HARD RESET
parameters.behaviour: Clears the accumulation buffer on a rising edge.

parameters.label: Source Type
parameters.behaviour: Selects the procedural source that is scanned.

parameters.label: Source Detail
parameters.behaviour: Controls structural density of the selected source.

parameters.label: Source Scale
parameters.behaviour: Scales the generated source before acquisition.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets automatic scan speed.

lineage.author: stihilus
lineage.sourceLicence: No licence file identified during reference review
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the progressive scanner-acquisition principle of stihilus' Glitch Scanner / Scanner Simulator. Scan Accumulator replaces user-image input with internally generated procedural sources and adds temporal accumulation, age-based hold, smear and multi-axis scanning.

development.limitations: Hold values shorter than a display frame cannot be visually distinguished continuously at normal frame rates. Direction and Source Type are discrete manual switches.

copy.short: Looking at the stars above us is always amazing
copy.about: Generates three related geometric systems around a shared language of harmonic Ratio, Phase, Eccentricity and Drift. True path intersections can be detected and marked independently, turning crossings into a second graphic layer.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; three shared-parameter geometric systems; discrete harmonic-ratio table; orbital harmonic displacement; closed Lissajous cycles at full Arc Length; ratio-driven constellation links; exact segment intersection tests with centered circular markers; transparent output; independent marker radius and line/marker stroke width.

parameters.label: System
parameters.behaviour: Switches between Orbital / Arcs, Lissajous and Constellation geometries.
parameters.explanation: Chooses the geometric system

parameters.label: Amount
parameters.behaviour: Sets the number of trajectories or constellation nodes generated by the active system.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Scales the complete geometric system relative to the canvas.

parameters.label: Ratio
parameters.behaviour: Selects one of nine harmonic ratios (1:1, 1:2, 2:3, 3:4, 3:5, 4:5, 5:6, 5:8, 8:13) and applies that relationship to the geometry of every System.
parameters.explanation: Controls the harmonic relationship used

parameters.label: Phase
parameters.behaviour: Offsets the angular / harmonic phase of the active geometry.
parameters.explanation: Shifts the internal relationship between repeated curves and oscillations.

parameters.label: Eccentricity
parameters.behaviour: Pushes circular relationships toward elliptical / stretched forms.
parameters.explanation: Controls the asymmetry between the geometry's main axes.

parameters.label: Arc Length
parameters.behaviour: Controls how much of each trajectory is drawn.

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.behaviour: Adds continuous harmonic displacement and orbital wandering

parameters.label: Intersection
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many true segment crossings are marked.
parameters.explanation: Reveals calculated intersections between independent trajectories

parameters.label: Intersection Size
parameters.behaviour: Controls only the radius of the circular intersection markers.

parameters.label: Line Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the stroke thickness of trajectories and the outline thickness of intersection circles.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the internal motion clock. At 0 BPM the geometry is static.

lineage.author: Yordan Stoyanov
lineage.sourceLicence: No public repository / licence identified during reference review
lineage.publicText: Inspired by selected geometry experiments in Yordan Stoyanov's Brand Assets Generator. Orbital Geometry is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D tool for this project.

development.limitations: Intersection detection is intentionally bounded for realtime use. High Amount with dense crossing structures can increase CPU cost. System is a discrete manual switch.

copy.short: I've loved them for as long as I can remember; there's something sloth-like and peaceful about them.
copy.about: Generates a bounded population of morphing zero-gravity blobs. Viscosity and Wandering shape their motion; Merge moves same-color families from separation toward shared liquid masses; Turbulence warps the field; up to three controllable color groups interact and create mixed-color zones only where different blobs genuinely overlap.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; deterministic bounded blob pool; continuously morphing implicit masses; zero-gravity 2D wandering; soft containment; same-color merge / exclusion physics; transient cross-color pass-through; local mixed-color contact rendering; progressive multi-scale turbulence; smooth high-Merge family seal underlay; optional transparent background.

parameters.label: Amount
parameters.behaviour: Sets the active number of autonomous blobs in the field.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.behaviour: Controls the base radius of the blobs before deterministic per-blob size variation.

parameters.label: Viscosity
parameters.behaviour: Controls mobility and damping of the blob simulation.

parameters.label: Merge
parameters.behaviour: Moves same-color interaction from exclusion toward overlap, shared-field influence and visible fusion.

parameters.label: Wandering
parameters.behaviour: Controls the strength of organic zero-gravity roaming in two dimensions.

parameters.label: Turbulence
parameters.behaviour: Warps the blob field through several animated spatial frequencies.
parameters.explanation: The first half increases broad deformation; above the midpoint additional higher-frequency warp enters progressively rather than switching modes.

parameters.label: Color Groups
parameters.behaviour: Chooses how many color families are assigned cyclically across the active blob population.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.behaviour: Regenerates deterministic initial blob positions, sizes, phases and drift characteristics.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the global internal motion clock.

lineage.author: BeerBelgio
lineage.publicText: Inspired by BeerBelgio's own interactive Lava Engine used on beerbelgio.github.io. Lava Lamp is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D tool with Sketch-compatible controls, zero-gravity roaming, merge / fusion and local cross-color blending.

development.limitations: No shader/gradient-like coloring where blobs overlap. I'll stick with the '70s vibe.

copy.short: Imagine seeing an electrostatic energy field in a couple of colors, maybe across a couple of materials too.
copy.about: Generates a field of animated trajectories driven by four structural modes. Lines respond to vector flow, local wave warp and attract/repel poles; increasing Pole Count disperses those deformation centres across the canvas and weakens their individual pull, while Spread lets paths peel away from the shared field.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; deterministic emitter families; four vector-field topologies; localized attract/repel pole field with count-dependent spatial dispersion and force attenuation; per-line dual-frequency local warp; progressive per-line spread; deterministic accent subset; transparent output.

parameters.label: System Shape
parameters.behaviour: Switches between four flow-field topologies: concentric/orbital, parallel, converging and resonance.

parameters.label: Density
parameters.behaviour: Sets the number of animated paths generated in the field.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.behaviour: Scales the overall field radius / spatial extent.

parameters.label: Flow
parameters.behaviour: Strengthens the underlying vector-field motion and exaggerates each System Shape's directional behaviour.
parameters.explanation: Controls how strongly the lines follow the system's flow logic.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Adds local dual-wave distortion along each individual line as well as field-level curvature.
parameters.explanation: Distorts the geometry of the lines

parameters.label: Pole Force
parameters.behaviour: Controls how strongly the attract/repel poles bend nearby trajectories.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'Pole Count'

parameters.label: Pole Count
parameters.behaviour: Sets the actual number of deformation poles. Higher counts disperse them farther across the canvas, reduce each pole's individual pull and increase effective line dispersion.
parameters.mapping: Map it along or in contrast with 'Pole Force'

parameters.label: Path Length
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many integration steps are used to extend each trajectory.

parameters.label: Spread
parameters.behaviour: Separates emitters and progressively disperses individual paths, while relaxing the system's containment at high values.

parameters.label: Line Width
parameters.behaviour: Sets the stroke width of the generated paths.

parameters.label: Accent
parameters.behaviour: Sets the proportion of paths redrawn with the Accent Color.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the internal speed of the continuous field motion.

lineage.author: Nikolaj Sokolowski
lineage.sourceLicence: Restricted reference source — no redistribution of patterns, node graphs or generators
lineage.publicText: Inspired by selected flow / physics studies from Book of Shapes. Electrostatic Field is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D field system for this project.
lineage.specificReference: Flow Poles · Wavy Lines Converging · Resonance Field

development.limitations: High Density, Pole Count and Path Length combinations increase CPU cost. Poles are invisible force centres rather than rendered objects.

copy.short: The first time I tried it, it just looked like Homer Simpson's two lonely hairs.
copy.about: Builds a repeated family from one source curve then transforms each copy through spacing, displacement, phase offset, scale, rotation, warp and travelling propagation.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; four base-curve systems; progressive repetition engine; normal-based displacement; secondary warp layer; scale and rotation steps; propagation-based cascading deformation with speed decoupled from playback BPM; transparent output.

parameters.label: Base Curve
parameters.behaviour: Switches between Arc, Sine, Bezier and Loop as the source curve family.

parameters.label: Repetitions
parameters.behaviour: Sets how many copies of the base curve are generated.

parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.behaviour: Controls how far the repeated copies spread across the family envelope.

parameters.label: Displacement
parameters.behaviour: Controls the main deformation amount applied along the normal of each curve copy.

parameters.label: Phase Offset
parameters.behaviour: Offsets phase from one copy to the next.

parameters.label: Scale Step
parameters.behaviour: Applies a progressive scale difference across the repetition family.

parameters.label: Rotation Step
parameters.behaviour: Applies a progressive rotation difference across the repetition family.

parameters.label: Curve Tension
parameters.behaviour: Controls how strongly the base curve bends or lobes. Higher values now mean stronger tension / deformation.
parameters.explanation: Sets the intrinsic curvature intensity of the mother curve.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.behaviour: Adds a second deformation layer with different frequency behaviour.
parameters.explanation: Acts as a secondary warping component beyond the main displacement.
parameters.mapping: Pairs well with Displacement for richer motion.

parameters.label: Propagation
parameters.behaviour: Controls how deformation phase cascades across the repetition family. Internal gain is intentionally extreme (x5)
parameters.explanation: Changes the delay / travel logic of the transformation from one copy to another without changing Motion BPM.

parameters.label: Line Width
parameters.behaviour: Controls the stroke thickness of all repeated curves.

parameters.label: Motion BPM
parameters.behaviour: Sets the internal motion clock. At 0 BPM the system is static.

lineage.author: Yordan Stoyanov
lineage.sourceLicence: No public repository / licence identified during reference review
lineage.publicText: Inspired by selected curve-repetition studies in Yordan Stoyanov's Brand Assets Generator. Homer's Hair is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D tool for this project.
lineage.specificReference: Tracery lines · curve repetition · geometric displacement

copy.short: They do seem like sticky plants, but they were actually a branching coral system.
copy.about: Generates a family of coral-like line structures that branch, fork and build ribbed fan patterns across the canvas. The system can grow inward from each edge or appear at random in-canvas origins, shifting between tidy formations and more irregular, asymmetrical growth.
copy.implementation: Canvas2D; deterministic procedural branching system; inward edge-growth and in-canvas random modes; rib generation tied to main branches; spread used as spatial dispersion rather than bouquet opening; asymmetry influences both growth path and origin placement; transparent output.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.behaviour: Selects the coral spawning mode.
parameters.explanation: Modes 0–3 grow inward from a specific edge; mode 4 places corals randomly in the canvas

parameters.label: Branches
parameters.behaviour: Controls how many coral organisms are generated.

parameters.label: Forking
parameters.behaviour: Controls the strength and frequency of branching within each coral.

parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.behaviour: Controls the base separation between neighboring corals.
parameters.mapping: Useful against Spread for compression/expansion gestures.

parameters.label: Spread
parameters.behaviour: Expands the colony across the canvas.

parameters.label: Width
parameters.behaviour: Sets the line width of both the main branches and the ribs.

parameters.label: Wobble
parameters.behaviour: Adds waviness and irregular bending to the lines.

parameters.label: Growth
parameters.behaviour: Controls how much of the coral is drawn.
parameters.explanation: Acts like a reveal/progression parameter for the colony.

parameters.label: Rib Density
parameters.behaviour: Sets how many lateral ribs appear along the coral branches.
parameters.explanation: Spikes on cactus or leaves on a plant?

parameters.label: Rib Length
parameters.behaviour: Controls how far the ribs extend from the main branches.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.behaviour: Changes the deterministic arrangement of the coral colony.
parameters.explanation: A new seed changes origin positions, directional variance and branching distribution

parameters.label: Asymmetry
parameters.behaviour: Introduces irregularity to both origin placement and coral growth.

lineage.author: PLAYGRND / PlayLab
lineage.sourceLicence: No code or licence reuse; reference-only visual research
lineage.publicText: Inspired by the Coral generator on PLAYGRND. Sticky Plants is an independently implemented standalone Canvas2D branching system focused on coral-like growth, ribs and colony distribution.
